name: Voxel Data Structure
definition: A data structure representing a single voxel, storing density as a half-precision float (fp16), a material ID, and flags. It occupies 4 bytes per voxel.
summary: The Voxel Data Structure stores per-voxel attributes in a compact memory layout to address bandwidth constraints in dense volume rendering, differing from sibling structures by offering variants that trade attribute richness for size.
